claim_supported: 13 RCTs in adults with overweight/obesity: TC -6.71 mg/dL, LDL -3.21 mg/dL, HDL -1.16 mg/dL, TG not significant; authors: below thresholds for CV risk reduction, does not justify routine use outside research
8 RCTs in metabolic disorders: slight decreases in TG, TC and LDL; HDL heterogeneous
Pooled TC, LDL and TG reductions with small-to-moderate effect sizes; 5 of 7 authors from the Novi Sad Applied Bioenergetics Lab
Untreated hypercholesterolemia, 0.9 L/day HRW 10 weeks: no change in plasma HDL-C; HDL function improved; effective rate for lowering TC 47.06% vs 17.65% and LDL 47.06% vs 23.53%

Obese adults, 1 L/day HRW (15 mg H2) 8 weeks: TC fell ~0.32 mmol/L in HRW group, significant interaction vs placebo for TC (p=0.02) and LDL (p=0.04); drinks supplied by Natural Wellness Now Health Products, which employs a co-author (full text, PMC12300559)

Metabolic syndrome, HRW tablets >5.5 mmol H2/day for 24 weeks: blood cholesterol reduced vs placebo; lead author Molecular Hydrogen Institute; tablets from HRW Natural Health Products (full text, PMC7102907); run in Moradabad, India
30 T2DM + 6 IGT, 900 mL/day 8 weeks: modified LDL -15.5%, small dense LDL -5.7%
Potential metabolic syndrome, 0.9-1.0 L/day 10 weeks: decreased serum TC and LDL-C; no control group
Potential metabolic syndrome, 1.5-2 L/day 8 weeks: HDL +8% from baseline to week 4; no control group
ApoE knockout mice drinking H2 water from 2 to 6 months: smaller atherosclerotic lesions, lower aortic oxidative stress
Magnesium hydride augmented atorvastatin's lipid-lowering effect; authors propose MgH2 inhibits hepatic CYP3A, raising statin blood levels (possible interaction)
T2DM: no significant difference in HOMA-IR change (primary endpoint) vs filtered water; lactate decreased in EHW group; no treatment-related adverse effects; two authors Nihon Trim
900 mL/day 8 weeks: lower modified LDL and urinary 8-isoprostanes; OGTT normalized in 4 of 6 IGT patients
Impaired fasting glucose, 1 L/day HRW (1.4 mg/L) 8 weeks: fasting glucose fell in both groups, more with HRW; return to normal glucose 68.8% vs 53.8%, not significant (full text, PMC10295603)
Metabolic syndrome, 24 weeks: reduced blood glucose and HbA1c vs placebo; lead author Molecular Hydrogen Institute
MetS/pre-MetS, 3 months EHW (Nihon Trim device) vs filtered water: HbA1c and glucose rose with FW and fell with EHW, no significant difference; Nihon Trim co-author
T2DM on usual medicine, 6 months: HbA1c -0.94% with H2 inhalation vs -0.46% without; not randomized
T2DM, 6 months H2 inhalation: HbA1c 9.04% to 8.00%; no control group; most common adverse event hypoglycemia
db/db mice drinking H2 water long term: lower glucose, insulin, TG, less fatty liver, controlled fat and body weight without more food intake; hyperglycemia effect similar to diet restriction
Overweight mild-to-moderate NAFLD, 1 L/day HRW 28 days: MRI liver fat reduced vs placebo (p<0.05); AST -10.0% (95% CI -23.2 to 3.4); no difference in weight/body composition; LeBaron (MHI) co-author
NAFLD, 8 weeks HRW: no significant change in liver enzymes; non-significant trends to ~1 kg weight loss, better lipids, higher 8-OHdG and MDA

design: human (placebo-controlled; randomization not stated in abstract)
claim_supported: NAFLD, 17 HRW tablets (3 x 330 mL/day, >4 mg/L) vs 13 placebo, 8 weeks: platelet CoQ10 up, plasma TBARS down in H2 group; non-significant in placebo; lab measures
IFG patients with fatty liver on ultrasound at baseline: remission 62.5% (10/16) HRW vs 31.6% (6/19) pure water, marginally significant
13-week hydrogen/oxygen inhalation: improved serum lipids and liver enzymes; liver fat (ultrasound, CT) improved significantly in moderate-severe cases
8 RCTs, various liver function disorders: slight decreases in ALT, AST and ALP with HRW vs plain water (not in our studies table; PubMed link)
MCD-diet NASH mice, 8 weeks HRW: lower ALT, TNF-a, IL-6, 8-OHdG, apoptosis, similar to pioglitazone; STAM mice: fewer liver tumors
H2 water alleviated fatty liver in db/db mice and in high-fat-diet wild-type mice

Obese adults 8 weeks: no significant between-group difference in body size or composition; men -2.0 kg within-group (interaction trend p=0.07); cravings (primary) and GLP-1 improved vs placebo; company-supplied drinks (full text, PMC12300559)
Overweight women, H2-generating mineral caplets 4 weeks: no difference in weight, BMI, circumferences; body fat % -3.2 vs -0.9% (p=0.05); TG -21.3 vs -6.5% (p=0.04)
Metabolic syndrome 24 weeks: cholesterol and glucose reduced; H2 tended to promote a mild reduction in BMI and waist-to-hip ratio (abstract wording)
Waist circumference reduction greater with EHW only in the high-physical-activity subgroup; Nihon Trim co-author

Healthy workers, 1.5 L/day ERW vs mineral water 8 weeks: significant group x time interaction for total, visceral, subcutaneous fat mass; authors conclude decreased fat mass; H2 content not reported in abstract
NAFLD: non-significant trend toward ~1 kg weight decrease with HRW
Healthy young women, 60-minute H2 inhalation at rest: lower respiratory exchange ratio vs air (increased resting fat oxidation)
Pooled lipid outcomes only (TC and LDL small reductions) in adults with overweight/obesity; no weight meta-analysis found
db/db mice: long-term H2 water controlled fat and body weight without more diet/water intake; stimulated energy metabolism (oxygen consumption)

Healthy men, 500 mL/day AEW (0.3 mg/L H2, pH 9.5) 2 weeks: Bristol stool scale converged to type 4; Bifidobacterium increased; no alpha-diversity change; lead author Panasonic, Panasonic device (full text, PMC8374459)
Healthy adults, >=500 mL/day AEW (0.2 mg/L H2, pH 9.2) 4 weeks: no clear effect on GI symptoms; stools slightly more normal in AEW group; two Panasonic authors (full text, PMC6352572)

IBS-D, >=2 L/day alkaline-reduced water 8 weeks: IBS-QOL improved more than placebo (p=0.029); overall relief 61.5% vs 42.9% (p=0.449) and abdominal pain (p=0.232) not significant; H2 content not reported in abstract
IFG, 1 L/day HRW 8 weeks: HRW modified gut microbiota dysbiosis vs placebo water (16S)
Female juvenile soccer players, 2 months HRW: diversity indices rose above controls, but groups differed before the trial and gut flora composition did not change significantly

Active UC, 5-6% H2 vs air 4 h/day 8 weeks (5 vs 5): beta-diversity change differed; between-group Mayo endoscopic subscore change significant (p=0.02); CAI not different; authors: no clear therapeutic effect; MiZ Co. devices (full text, PMC12383636)
DSS colitis mice: adding H2 to the DSS drinking water for 7 days suppressed weight loss, colitis score, colon shortening and colonic IL-12, TNF-a, IL-1b
